purpose: Refresh the complete six-URL source set for all seven cases in the unchanged September 8 guidance comparator. Retain newly retrieved source versions and review every case for unchanged or revised guidance, explicit attained events, explicit nonoccurrence or cancellation, and unknowns. A source refresh is not a new prediction or proof of current physical state.
policy_basis: The main reviewer read all 90 lines of the current NIST robots policy and the complete Copyrights & Disclaimers page on September 10. The six /chips/ routes are outside the robots exclusions. NIST permits copying public information except marked copyright and product-specific exceptions. Preserve source attribution; inspect page-specific notices. Use the established collector to reacquire both exact canonical policies and require their previously reviewed normalized hashes before any document request; drift or failed policies block all documents. This is a new exact-URL decision, not reuse of an expired acquisition approval.

selection.population: All seven already frozen cases, including three issued intervals, three abstentions and one excluded aggregate; six unique NIST pages, no outcome-based selection.

prior_exposure: The frozen source statements, previous outcome screens and an unadmitted SK hynix schedule discrepancy have been seen. This is not blind outcome review or source-coverage proof. No issuer, mirror or previously denied route is authorized; unchanged NIST wording cannot resolve an unverified external discrepancy or establish nonoccurrence.
